name: Proxy and storage-collision defects beyond plain upgrade
requires: a proxy pattern: EIP-1967, EIP-1822/UUPS, beacon, minimal, or a diamond
inheritance order or a storage layout that could collide
an upgrade or initializer entry point
questions: Is the implementation slot the canonical EIP-1967 slot, or a custom slot that collides with layout?
Does the implementation contract have state variables at slot 0 that clash with the proxy's admin?
Is the initializer guarded by initialized flags that the implementation itself shares?
Can initialize be called on the implementation directly (uninitialized implementation)?
Does the diamond's facet storage follow the diamond-storage convention, or free-form?
Is upgradeTo callable without an onlyOwner, or with a check on a spoofable field?
Does delegatecall pass through msg.value or msg.sender in a way the facet trusts?
After an upgrade, is any newly added variable placed after all existing ones?
false_positives: OpenZeppelin upgrades plugin guarantees the layout, and the layout was actually validated
The implementation is immutable and cannot be initialized post-deploy
The custom slot is a keccak-derived constant far from layout range
The proxy is a beacon whose owner is a timelock with a real delay
poc_must_show: the two storage reads that collide, printed with slot numbers
the resulting corrupted value an attacker can set or read
a control read showing the value before corruption
no privileged role used, or the role named
impact_bar: Reportable when collision or an unguarded upgrade lets an unprivileged caller change privileged state or read/write another account's storage. Informational for a pattern that is merely unusual.
